text.tspan: Writable working roles additionally bind the verified durable run-header digest and exact step endpoint; input content alone is not mutable identity
Existing native case/history/prior and budget admission precedes construction; activation never enters the native case key or changes compiler flags

Existing Make consumes explicit completed GeneratedCArtifact, native C leaf delta, ABI and the existing configured BUILD commands; no additional profile or executor. Never silently upgrade the compiler service or issue arbitrary Scheme-query freshness

Native-only phase3/phase4 replaces gsc-boot with a non-executable directory gate and restores it afterward; complete generated artifact and original producer hashes stay unchanged. Unexpected generation fails; fixture Scheme compilation is accounted separately

g.text: One task-cache development workspace selected by an origin-bound route for first build, no-change rebuild and actual C-leaf edit; no per-run activation key, implicit clean, replacement tree or end-of-run full-tree snapshot. Origin replacement requires explicit rebase. Build entry reconciles active custody without global retention; native run returns its receipt without catalog evaluation

Existing configure_owned_source is the single owner of full output hashes and actual completed configure receipt. Same selected source/template/profile/tool/environment request skips aclocal/autoconf/configure; C leaf bodies are not configuration inputs. SDK/system replacement requires task-profile requalification; no general read-effect closure issued
Validation identity and lifetime / fresh execution stays separate
Three compilations / five fresh executions; original context retained
